settings.headline: Let's find
settings.subtitle: Answer a few questions and we'll reply within two working days with a fixed quote. No payment, no obligation.

settings.small_print: We only use your answers to plan your trip. Sending this doesn't commit you to anything.

steps.title: We read it
steps.text: A planner reads every answer. Your request stays private.

steps.title: We send a quote
steps.text: Within two working days, by email, with a fixed price.

steps.title: You decide
steps.text: Say yes and we book. Say no and that's that.

settings.aside: Prices on this site are guides. When you're happy with your quote we send a booking agreement and a secure invoice by email. Nothing is charged here.
